title: SEP-41 classifier requires wallet-backend's exact parameter names, so tokens written to the SEP-41 interface are never tracked

target.versions_affected: 3e22515a44979fdc3a558fda3991ca2b48e38cef and e967ce8b7362b79c277e700e789181d76fbb5967 (the code is identical; range not established)

severity_basis: wasmspec.Match compares parameter names as well as types and order, and several required names differ from SEP-41, soroban-sdk 23-25's TokenInterface and OpenZeppelin (to: MuxedAddress, live_until_ledger, account, owner). An unclassified contract produces no state changes, so wallets built on wallet-backend show nothing for these tokens until the contract's code changes. Not attacker-triggered.

entries.expected: a contract that matches SEP-41 by function, parameter types and order is classified as SEP-41
entries.observed: Not run by the kit against wallet-backend. By hand at 3e22515a: services.NewWasmSpecExtractor and matchSEP41Spec return false for this entry's wasm (testnet df3524d3…), one of the four real wasm the issue lists.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. At wallet-backend 3e22515a, the issue's steps (services.NewWasmSpecExtractor, then matchSEP41Spec, as TestValidator_RealWasm does) return false for the four real wasm it lists (pubnet 72eb5d52…, 0a41411f…, 7fc336be…; testnet df3524d3…), and renaming only the parameters to wallet-backend's names makes the match pass.
evidence.expected_basis: SEP-41 (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/master/ecosystem/sep-0041.md) names transfer's destination to: MuxedAddress and approve's expiry live_until_ledger; Soroban arguments are positional, so parameter names add no protection against spoofing.

reproduction.method: Re-run on 2026-11-18 at 3e22515a on the corpus copy of testnet wasm df3524d3… (contract-spec/token-with-renamed-parameters): matchSEP41Spec returns false, as the issue states.

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-18: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-14 as https://github.com/stellar/wallet-backend/issues/809; this record restates the public issue.
